title: North Pole postmark window opens Monday for Pontotoc families mailing holiday letters
excerpt: USPS recommends mailing a prepared reply for a North Pole postmark by Dec. 1. Families writing to Operation Santa have a different address and a Dec. 5 postmark deadline.
locality: Federal mail services available to Pontotoc, Mississippi, residents, including the local post office on Highway 15 North.

facts.statement: Pontotoc families who want a letter returned with a North Pole postmark can start mailing it Monday, Nov. 23. The Postal Service recommends sending it by Tuesday, Dec. 1, to allow time for the letter to go to Anchorage, Alaska, for the postmark and then back to the child. The Pontotoc post office at 305 Highway 15 North will be closed Thanksgiving Day and will reopen Friday.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc families who want a letter returned with a North Pole postmark can start mailing it Monday, Nov. 23. The Postal Service recommends sending it by Tuesday, Dec. 1, to allow time for the letter to go to Anchorage, Alaska, for the postmark and then back to the child. The Pontotoc post office at 305 Highway 15 North will be closed Thanksgiving Day and will reopen Friday.

For this keepsake, a parent or caregiver writes the reply to the child and signs it from Santa. Put the reply and the child’s letter in a stamped envelope addressed to the child, with Santa at the North Pole as the return address. Place that envelope inside a larger one and pay postage on the outer envelope as well.
Address the outer envelope to North Pole Postmark, Postmaster, 4141 Postmark Dr., Anchorage, AK 99530-9998. The postmaster applies the special cancellation to the inner envelope for its return trip.

Families sending a wish list to USPS Operation Santa use a different destination. Address that letter to Santa Claus, 123 Elf Rd., North Pole, 88888, and have it postmarked by Saturday, Dec. 5. Eligible letters may be posted for volunteers to adopt. USPS says adoption and fulfillment are not guaranteed. Approved volunteers can adopt letters until 7 p.m. Central on Saturday, Dec. 12.
